applies_to.quote: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks - Prudential Norms on Capital Adequacy) Eighth Amendment Directions, 2026

answer.action: Apply the specified risk weights of 100%, 125%, or 150% to exposures and lending to Real Estate Investment Trusts.
answer.action_quote: Exposures to Real Estate Investment Trusts (REITs) shall be treated as Commercial Real Estate (CRE) exposures and shall attract a risk weight of 100 per cent.

effective_date.quote: These Directions shall come into force from October 1, 2026, or an earlier date if the directions contained in the Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Credit Facilities) Third Amendment Directions, 2026 are adopted by a bank in entirety.

answer.amends: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Prudential Norms on Capital Adequacy) Directions, 2025
